name: Aoi Sora no Neosphere
original_name: 蒼い空のネオスフィア
source: A sequel of Tristia of the Deep-Blue Sea from Kogado Studio(Kumasan Team). Set in the Neosphere kingdom that fly in the air by ancient E technology. Neosphere kept going to ruin after world union war. And then, Nanoca was called to rebuild the kingdom.
translation: 工画堂工作室（小熊组）《苍海的特利斯提亚》的续作。故事发生在依靠古代E科技漂浮于空中的新沃尔法王国。世界统一战争后，新沃尔法持续走向衰败。于是，奈奈香受召前来重建王国。
